description: Replacement of existing projecting sign with new double sided externally illuminated projecting sign to southern elevation of the building; replacement of linolite lighting with warm white illumination (below 300 cd/m�), re-lamping of 3 lanterns (low luminance), retention of menu case and directional lighting, retention and repainting of boundary planters to southern elevation of the building; retention of menu case and directional lighting (to the corner elevation facing and Uxbridge Road and Adelaide Grove).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date on which this consent is granted.

Condition required to be imposed by Section 18(1) (a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended by section 91 of the Planning and Compensation Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

157-ADV01 REV A
157-EL-01 REV B
Signage Scheme: Hanging Sign Graphic and Signage Details

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below: 

Replacement double-sided projecting signage: Timber (jet black RAL 9005) with vinyl detailing & gold lettering. Existing bracket and framework to be retained. 

Boundary treatment: Black painted timber material. 

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. All disturbed surfaces shall be made good using materials to match the existing materials, composition, form, finish and colour of the existing building. 

To preserve the significance of the subject Listed Building and the character and appearance of the surrounding area, in accordance with Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle AH2 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
